name: Twisted Love
source:
In 1973, you tag along on a road trip with your friends when suddenly the trip takes an unexpected turn. Now all of you are fighting to survive and trying to find a way out... Worse of all, one of the cultists leaders has an obsessive fascination with you...  Can you and your friends make it out alive before the end of the week or die trying? 

[From [url=https://twizztedstudios.itch.io/twisted-love]Itch.io[/url]]
